name: Decommissioning and well abandonment
principle: Options for a disused offshore installation include full removal, leaving the substructure intact, topping and toppling. OSPAR Decision 98/3 generally prohibits leaving installations in place, with narrow derogations.

process_steps.name: Remove topsides and substructure, or apply a derogation
